messages.subject: accessing internal functions
parts:
Hi,
I'm trying to program my own fit function based on the existing one for
ProbeLevelModel. But there are functions and variables (e.g. getRam and
aromaSettings). I would like to be able to send this to a collaborator,
so I don't want to have to source the R files (and I don't want to
figure out which R files). Normally I would do ':::', but there's no
namespace so it doesn't work. In fact I don't even know which package
they are associated with. How can I call these functions/variables?
Thanks,
Elizabeth
